parameters.content:
## 1 of 2 — when an enquiry arrives

Your website form posts here. In order, this workflow:

1. reads the form, whatever the plugin calls its fields
2. throws out spam and anything with no usable email
3. picks the owner from the postcode
4. **writes the row to the sheet first**, so an enquiry can never be
   lost to a mail failure
5. emails the customer the three standard questions
6. emails the owner the details

Everything you edit is in the **config** node.

## Nothing is sent until you say so

`TEST_RUN = true` with a blank `TEST_EMAIL` (how it ships) writes the sheet row
but sends no email. Open **STOP: preview - nothing sent** to read exactly what
the customer and the owner would have got.

Put your own address in `TEST_EMAIL` and the emails really send, to you.
`TEST_RUN = false` goes live.
